description: T-3584: MATCH's exact-match (type 0) fold per character and the characters Excel's comparison table seems to lack. Data!A1 = UNICHAR(1316) (U+0524), Data!A2 = empty text. Part 1, Calc!A1:H32: pairs Data!C (x) vs Data!D (y), A label, B x=y, C EXACT, D COUNTIF(y,x), E MATCH(x,y,0) (0 = #N/A), F XMATCH(x,y,0), G VLOOKUP(x,y,1,FALSE) found, H HLOOKUP found. Part 2, Calc!J1:P85: Data!F char vs candidates Data!G:I, J label, K:M MATCH(char,cand,0) found, N MATCH(char, empty text) found, O MATCH(char, U+0524) found, P char=first candidate. Part 3, Calc!R1:R256: BMP page sweep, R(p+1) covers U+p00..U+pFF, one hex digit per code point: 1 = MATCH equals U+0524, 2 = MATCH equals empty text, 4 = (u=""), 8 = (u=U+0524), e = UNICHAR errors. Part 4, Calc!T1:U1232: per character of blocks Greek, Greek Extended, Latin Ext-D, Cyrillic Ext-B, Coptic, Cherokee, Cherokee Supplement, Georgian, Cyrillic Ext-C + Georgian Mtavruli, Georgian Supplement (Data!K, one per row), T = the hex codes in its block that MATCH(..,0) equals it with (itself included), U its code.
